title: GPT Image 2.5 Prompt
description: Schema for a single GPT Image 2.5 text-to-image prompt

id.description: Unique identifier, slugified from the title (e.g. 'vintage-national-park-stamps')

content.description: The exact prompt text that produced the image (English)

description.description: Brief description of the prompt effect (max 200 chars, English)

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the prompt text is written in

sourceLink.description: Link to the original post (X/Twitter, etc.)

thumbnail.description: The generated image. MUST be an https://assets.renoise.ai/... URL — hotlinked third-party images rot and are not re-served.

referenceImages.description: Reference images used as input. Normally empty: this collection only holds prompts that reproduce from text alone.

tips.description: Usage tips and tricks for this prompt (English)
